newsitem.title: USA: CME hog, pork belly calls range mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME hog, pork belly calls range mixed.

text.p: Early calls on CME lean hog futures ranged from 0.200 cent per lb lower to 0.100 higher while calls on pork belly futures ranged from 0.250 higher to 0.300 lower, livestock analysts said.

Most analysts anticipate carryover selling pressure in hog futures following lower cash hog indications early Tuesday and a weak product market. Hog runs increased Monday and both domestic and export demand for pork has been running under expectations, they said.
However, others consider the market oversold and cite holding of a technical level Monday for support.
